not_covered: New initial orientations, weakened actuators, terrain or impacts
Robot self-collision response or continuous-time path clearance
A complete broad torque-map cohort or another unchanged-grid comparison
Reaction feedback, learned force models or memory-based adaptation
A matched estimate of added telemetry cost or native throughput improvement
qualification_economy: Reuse the shared owner, native worker, full replay, compact projection and route reader. Ten v3 controls cover narrow cones, analytic optima, old-version preservation, real dispatch, exact planning-memory capture and declaration refusals. Eight reaction controls cover the new physical observable: solved per-contact force, native frame and sign, solver decoding, free-root reconciliation, stream joins and capture timing. The reusable capture/decoder module is new because neither motor force nor prepared contact presence records this observable. All 312 predecessor controls remain, for 330 total; no new campaign-specific runner or audit.
purpose: Verify geometric force-cone feasibility, failed planning-state retention and measured solved contact reactions in 36 fresh three-second diagnostic worlds.
selection_rationale: Diagnostic route only. Retain the two prior route bodies (broad indices 0 and 16) and add broad body 21, which exposed the zero-friction refusal. Each receives all eight torque-map recipes plus four fresh comparator roles. The completed broad v2 candidates all lost to their selected reference; this route does not authorize repetition of that grid or select a new recovery winner.
braking_model_limit: Constant-velocity lookahead and a stopping-speed envelope using a declared 6 rad/s^2 shaping estimate. This is not a validated physical deceleration bound or a guarantee that no joint crosses its limit.
body_moment_limit: Clear geometric targets are not collision-free transitions. Geometric capsule low points are not measured contact locations. Friction cones and normal load are configured proposals; static joint compensation omits inertial, Coriolis, passive and limit forces. Actual force, contact and sampled work are retained. Motors, native collision filtering and eligibility remain unchanged.
code_path_risks_covered: Empty zero-friction and narrow-cone feasibility without relaxing force constraints
All eight pose/load/contact recipes on the two predecessor route bodies
The failed body 21 reaches explicit empty-target fallback in every new recipe
Failed observations and exact host planning state are retained before and after refusal
Solved force components are paired with their original contact frame and constraint addresses before the next preparation
Ground-first and ground-second signs, elliptic and pyramidal decoding, finite frames and strict stream joins have synthetic controls
Native measured contact-force sums reconcile with the six free-root generalized constraint forces
Full controller replay and the same-run compact projection remain mandatory
route_horizon_rationale: Three seconds on bodies 0 and 16 retain the predecessor coverage of repeated target updates, roll/pitch commands and loading transitions. Body 21 covers the interval-one zero-friction failure and repeated fallback decisions. Thirty-six worlds use three batches of twelve. Each new cell on the first two bodies must select a clear torque-map pose and emit bounded force; each new cell on body 21 must encounter empty-target fallback. Every native internal step retains solved reactions. Missing coverage or failed reconstruction consumes the attempt. This diagnostic does not qualify recovery or authorize a broad repeat.
torque_map_limit: A row-space ground force is a model choice. Static balance omits inertia, Coriolis, passive and joint-limit reactions. All observed canonical foot contacts are accounted for by a force or bounded zero-torque request; torso and upper-link reactions remain unmodeled. Zero torque can be unreachable during slew or joint protection, so the residual remains recorded. Geometric targets certify endpoint clearance only. No continuous path, dynamic feasibility, recovery, learned adaptation or release authority. Solved contact reactions are separately retained for diagnosis; they do not turn model force requests into measured controller inputs.
numerical_successor: V3 compares the actual minimum-force transverse distance to friction with a 32-double-epsilon roundoff allowance and constructs the remaining radius from factored transverse lengths. Preserve all final 1e-9 vector checks, rank/normal cutoffs, load/moment budgets and motor guards. V1/v2 arithmetic remains selected by its original policies. Failure capture includes exact pre-transfer targets and planning memory. Additional reaction telemetry observes the completed solver step and never feeds the controller.
